units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 9:2">Targ. Ez. IX, 2</cite>, sq. (h. text <he>קסת</he>). Targ. II Esth. IV, 1 <he>ופִינְקְסֵיה</he>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 5:4:5">Y. Sabb. V, end, 7ᶜ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00739"><he>גִּימוֹן</he></cite>. Ib. XII, end, 13ᵈ <he>מאן דאמר חוקק כגון ההן פ׳</he> he who says the term <cite ref="K01340"><he>כתב</he></cite> applies also to engraving, means engraving like that on the wax-covered tablet, opp. <he>בולט</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:6:9">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᵇ</cite> bot. I saw in my dream <he>לביש חד פ׳ וכ׳</he> (<he>דהוינא</he>) that I was covered with a pinax of twelve tablets; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>רבתי דהוינא טעין חד פ׳ וכ׳</he> (<he>חד כות׳</he>) that I was carrying a pinax &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:3:4">Y. Maasr. II, 49ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אשכחון כתיב בפִינַקְסֵיה וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="K01340"><he>כתב</he></cite>) they found written in a memorandum of &c.; a. e.—Pl. <he>פִּינַקְסִין</he>, constr. <he>פִּינְקְסֵי</he>, <cite ref="Q00721"><he>פִּנָ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 39:11">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIX, 11</cite>.
